headline: 8 watches, one budget: $795 to $2,225
stop_reason: Revision not applied. Slide 7 (Le Locle T932.207): the only library photo has a smear and the official Tissot page returns the same cached image, so no clean cut-out exists. Slide 2 (Khaki Field, same as cover): no fresh in-band (795-2225) watch from a collection not already used; library options are Jazzmaster H32755851 ($1,295, 21 Nov 2026) and Oris Artelier 01 733 7721 ($1,950, 21-24 Nov 2026), and Jazzmaster and Artelier already appear elsewhere in the list. Slide 9 (Le Locle T932.408): same gap. Needs owner direction on which collections to add, or a new research pass for fresh prices.
